scale-unlimited/declaration-strict-value.message: Use a --fwp-text-* token instead of a raw font-size value (rule lives in docs/rules/fwp-brand.md). `em` values are allowed (relative scaling).

color-no-hex.message: Use a --fwp-* token instead of a raw hex color (rule lives in docs/rules/fwp-brand.md).

media-feature-name-value-allowed-list.message: Use a canonical breakpoint tier (max-width 767/480/1023, min-width 768/1024/1440). Tokens + rationale in brand-tokens.css → BREAKPOINTS and docs/rules/responsive-layouts.md.

declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: Use var(--fwp-text-on-brand) or a scoped [color-scheme="dark"] override instead of color: white|black, AND never inline a hex fallback inside var(--fwp-*, #hex) — brand-tokens.css is the single source of truth (rules in docs/rules/{accessibility,design-polish,fwp-brand}.md).
